text: 옥탑방 때부터 꾸준히 좋아하고 있는 유일한 그룹. 방탄소년단도 좋아하고 워너원 등 많은 아이돌들을 좋아했지만, 엔플라잉만의 특유 분위기와 콘셉트가 몇 년이 지나도 잊히지 않는다. 내 초등학생 시절, 창문 너머 노을 보면서 옥탑방을 듣고 위로를 참 많이 받았는데, 이젠 아르바이트하며 들리는 승협의 목소리에 괜스레 뿌듯하기도 하고 종종 이렇게 찾아보게도 되는 것 같다 나만 알고싶지만 더 유명해져서 꽃길만 걷길 그때쯤이면 내가 사회에서 위로받고 싶을 때겠지

text: 진정한 걸작 앞에서 단 22분으로 만족하는 건 불가능해요 😡🔥N.Flying의 음악은 그냥 듣는 게 아니에요… 느끼는 거예요. 살아 숨 쉬는 거예요. 그리고 피부에 오래도록 남아요. 모든 N.Fia는 제가 무슨 말을 하는지 정확히 알고 있어요. 하지만 아직 모른다면, 지금이 바로 팬이 될 순간이에요. 이건 단순한 추천이 아니에요 — 소름 돋는 목소리, 마음을 감싸 안는 멜로디, 그리고 머리를 완전히 뒤흔드는 폭발적인 연주를 만나보라는 강력한 초대예요. 모든 음표에는 감정이 담겨 있고, 모든 노래에는 이야기가 있어요. 모든 무대는 진짜 실력이 존재한다는 걸 증명해요… 그리고 그 이름은 바로 N.Flying 🎸한 번 듣고 나면, 절대 돌아갈 수 없어요.

text: 우와 나 엔플라잉 잊고 살았었는데 옥탑방으로 뜨고 나서 엔플라잉한테 빠져서 그때 엔플라잉 콘서트 1번 갔다 왔습니다 장소가 좀 작고 소규모 콘서트여서 얼굴이 잘 보였습니다.승협님 진짜 팬들 보는 눈이 꿀 떨어지고 그때 한창 옥탑방 역주행으로뜨던 시절이라 신나 보이던 그 눈빛이 아직도 기억 납니다. 제가 혼자 가기 좀 뭐해서 친구도 데려 가는데, 친구도 끝나고 그 얘기 하더라구요. 현재 취업 하면서 잊고 살았는데, 이렇게 또 잘 된 모습 보니까 너무 좋습니다. 정말 꾸준하게 멋진 음악 하고 있었네요.엔플라잉 화이팅!!!

text:
The first time I came across N.Flying was on a YouTube programme hosted by Eunhyuk and Donghae from Super Junior. I remember being intrigued when the members said that, even though they no longer lived together, they had deliberately chosen to live only five minutes apart from one another. Then I stumbled across "Seung-hyub’s Camp" videos on YouTube and found myself laughing all the way through them. 
To be honest, band music isn’t really my style. So I only ended up liking two or three of their songs. Yet I watched the entire performance with a smile on my face and thoroughly enjoyed it. Because you don’t have to be a fan to respect and admire them or recognise how talented they are and to see the love, effort, and dedication they pour into both their music and their group.

text:
En agosto cumpliré 11 años como NFia. 

11 años de canciones, recuerdos, risas, lágrimas y momentos que jamás habría vivido si aquel día no hubiera decidido escuchar a N.Flying por primera vez. 

Dicen que las personas llegan a tu vida por una razón, y yo estoy convencida de que ustedes llegaron a la mía cuando más los necesitaba y sin darme cuenta, crecí junto a ustedes. Los vi luchar por sus sueños, enfrentar obstáculos y seguir adelante incluso cuando el camino parecía difícil. Y mientras ustedes avanzaban, yo también lo hacía. 

Gracias a ustedes me atreví a vivir experiencias que nunca imaginé. Ir a Corea y quedarme 3 años, viajé miles de kilómetros y recorrí distintos rincones del mundo para estar frente a ustedes una vez y escuchar las canciones que tantas veces me acompañaron y que tanto amo. 

Muchas personas creen que la música es solo música. Pero para mí, ustedes fueron mucho más que eso. Fueron compañía en los días más felices y también en aquellos en los que sentía que no podía seguir adelante. Hubo momentos en los que una sola canción bastó para darme consuelo y recordarme que todo estaría bien. 

Y si estos 11 años me enseñaron algo, es que el amor no conoce fronteras. Aunque nacimos en países diferentes y hablamos idiomas distintos, nunca sentí que existiera una distancia real entre nosotros, porque mi amor por ustedes es más grande que cualquier cosa. 

Por eso, cuando pienso en estos 11 años, no veo solo el tiempo que he pasado siendo fan. Veo una parte importante de mi vida. Veo recuerdos que atesoro y un camino junto a mis 5 personas favoritas en el mundo. 

Volvería a elegirlos, una y otra vez, sin dudarlo. 

Gracias por existir, juntos hasta los 80 años y más ¡Let's Roll!

Los esperamos en Chile 🇨🇱💙😭

text:
FINALLYYYYYYY I'VE BEEN WAITING FOR THIS BECAUSE N.FLYING IS SUCH A GREAT BAND! And here are my thoughts ☺️
1. 23 minutes isn't enough because all their songs are superrrrrr good
2. Why has Hun the cat become a lot cooler?? Mygosh, he is supposed to be cute but he has become so manly and more amazing!
3. Hweseung's voice is soulful, and the fact that he sings with a heart, the songs wrap me in different emotions, especially when he sings Flashback.
4. Dong has also become a lot cooler! And his face card is now crazy.
5. Jaehyun is one of the drummers I love watching perform. He is always into the piece he's playing, and at the same time he's veryyyy handsome. 
6. My Seunghyubiee, our leader~ Gosh! He's really the definition of the ALL ROUNDER ARTIST. Imagine going back and forth from standing to sitting down just to play two different instruments. Plus his voice blends well with Hweseung. His harmonization is superb! Alsooo, his lower register always makes me fall for him over and over again. 

THIS KILLING VOICE EPISODE IS DEFINITELY ♾️/10

text:
En agosto cumpliré 11 años como NFia. 

11 años de canciones, recuerdos, risas, lágrimas y momentos que jamás habría vivido si aquel día no hubiera decidido escuchar a N.Flying por primera vez. 

Dicen que las personas llegan a tu vida por una razón, y yo estoy convencida de que ustedes llegaron a la mía cuando más los necesitaba y sin darme cuenta, crecí junto a ustedes. Los vi luchar por sus sueños, enfrentar obstáculos y seguir adelante incluso cuando el camino parecía difícil. Y mientras ustedes avanzaban, yo también lo hacía. 

Gracias a ustedes me atreví a vivir experiencias que nunca imaginé. Ir a Corea y quedarme 3 años, viajé miles de kilómetros y recorrí distintos rincones del mundo para estar frente a ustedes una vez y escuchar las canciones que tantas veces me acompañaron y que tanto amo. 

Muchas personas creen que la música es solo música. Pero para mí, ustedes fueron mucho más que eso. Fueron compañía en los días más felices y también en aquellos en los que sentía que no podía seguir adelante. Hubo momentos en los que una sola canción bastó para darme consuelo y recordarme que todo estaría bien. 

Y si estos 11 años me enseñaron algo, es que el amor no conoce fronteras. Aunque nacimos en países diferentes y hablamos idiomas distintos, nunca sentí que existiera una distancia real entre nosotros, porque mi amor por ustedes es más grande que cualquier cosa. 

Por eso, cuando pienso en estos 11 años, no veo solo el tiempo que he pasado siendo fan. Veo una parte importante de mi vida. Veo recuerdos que atesoro y un camino junto a mis 5 personas favoritas en el mundo. 

Volvería a elegirlos, una y otra vez, sin dudarlo. 

Gracias por existir, juntos hasta los 80 años y más ¡Let's Roll!

Los esperamos en Chile 🇨🇱💙😭

I just came straight here after watching the MV for in between seasons, and now I get to hear it live! Thank you for finally letting N.flying appear. They have so many amazing songs, this doesn't even scratch the surface. I always recommend their songs to my friends - no one ever regrets becoming a fan of N.flying~

Even though I have been a fan for many years, I still can't believe this is really live! it's crazy how talented they are, it never fails to amaze me. I was lucky enough to attend their concert once, and it's was an unforgettable experience. It's the biggest compliment when fans prefer the live-versions over the recorded ones haha.

Thank you to N.flying for always working hard for us n.fia!

video_title: N.Flying (엔플라잉) ‘환절기 (換節期)’ MV
text:
En agosto cumpliré 11 años como NFia. 

11 años de canciones, recuerdos, risas, lágrimas y momentos que jamás habría vivido si aquel día no hubiera decidido escuchar a N.Flying por primera vez. 

Dicen que las personas llegan a tu vida por una razón, y yo estoy convencida de que ustedes llegaron a la mía cuando más los necesitaba. 

Sin darme cuenta, crecí junto a ustedes. Los vi luchar por sus sueños, enfrentar obstáculos y seguir adelante incluso cuando el camino parecía difícil. Y mientras ustedes avanzaban, yo también lo hacía. 

Gracias a ustedes me atreví a vivir experiencias que nunca imaginé. Ir a Corea y quedarme 3 años, viajé miles de kilómetros y recorrí distintos rincones del mundo para estar frente a ustedes una vez más y escuchar las canciones que tantas veces me acompañaron y que tanto amo. 

Muchas personas creen que la música es solo música. Pero para mí, ustedes fueron mucho más que eso. Fueron compañía en los días más felices y también en aquellos en los que sentía que no podía seguir adelante. Hubo momentos en los que una sola canción bastó para darme consuelo y recordarme que todo estaría bien. 

Y si estos 11 años me enseñaron algo, es que el amor no conoce fronteras. Aunque nacimos en países diferentes y hablamos idiomas distintos, nunca sentí que existiera una distancia real entre nosotros, porque mi amor por ustedes es más grande que cualquier cosa. 

Por eso, cuando pienso en estos 11 años, no veo solo el tiempo que he pasado siendo fan. Veo una parte importante de mi vida. Veo recuerdos que atesoro y un camino junto a mis 5 personas favoritas en el mundo. 

Volvería a elegirlos, una y otra vez, sin dudarlo. 

Gracias por existir, juntos hasta los 80 años y más ¡Let's Roll!

text:
Hi 🙂 Everyone, thank you NFlying. Let me share with you 3 of my favorite Bible verses: When you please the Lord, you can make your enemies into friends, Proverbs 16:7. What is desired in a man is kindness, Proverbs 19:22. Jesus taught us whom to fear, "Don't be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear God who can destroy both body and soul in hell." Matthew 10:28.

Although he was the King in Jerusalem, he worked! This is what he said, "I found pleasure in my work. This was my reward for all my hard work." Ecclesiastes 2:10.

Wise king Solomon said, "Activity is man's precious possession, Proverbs 12:27. It is the Lord's blessing that makes us wealthy. Hard work can make us no richer, Proverbs 10:22. It is useless to work so hard for a living, getting up early and going to bed late. For the Lord provides for those he loves, while they are asleep." Psalms 127:2.

Paul said, "We used to tell you, 'Whoever refuses to work is not allowed to eat.' 2 Thessalonians 3:10. Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as though you were working for the Lord and not for people. For Jesus is the real master you serve." Colossians 3:23,24.

"We encourage you as believers to excel in love. Also, make it your goal to live quietly, do your work, and earn your own living. 1 Thessalonians 4:10,11. Therefore, my dear brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that in the Lord your labor is not in vain." 1 Corinthians 15:58.

My work is to share Jesus' Good News and God's word. Hear what God said, "My word, which comes from my mouth, is like the rain. It will not come back to me without results. It will accomplish whatever I want and achieve whatever I send it to do." Isaiah 55:11.

Prayer:
Daddy God I ask you to bless all the Jews in the world. I ask you to protect them, to be kind to them and to give them your Shalom peace. May all the Jews believe that Jesus is the Messiah, then they will obey Jesus and follow him to heaven, so be it in Jesus' name, thank you so much Daddy God that Jesus said, "In my name ask and you will receive, that your joy may be full." John 16:24 Hallelujah!

I pray for all the people who are going to hell, but they think that they are going to heaven because the devil has deceived them, Revelation 20:10. I pray that they will hear Jesus' Good News, repent, that is turn away from their sins and become saved as Jesus said in Luke 15:10, so be it in Jesus' name, thank you so much Daddy God that Jesus said, "In my name ask and you will receive, that your joy may be full." John 16:24 Hallelujah!

Good News:
Do you know the Good News of how you can go to heaven? Believe now and say, "I have decided to follow Jesus, because he is the ONLY way to heaven, John 14:6. I turn away from all my sins, because Jesus said, 'From now on don't sin, John 8:11, a sinner REPENTS and becomes SAVED.' Luke 15:10. So be it in Jesus' name, Hallelujah!"

text: 우리에겐 2분 48초라는 짧은 노래일지 모르지만, 그 안에 담긴 1초의 디테일도 하나하나 신경 쓰며 고치고 노력하는 모습에 큰 감동을 받았어요. 아쉬운 부분이 있다면 머뭇거리지 않고 따뜻하게 이야기해주며 격려해주는 모습, 그리고 그걸 받아들이는 모습에 그동안의 쌓아온 멤버들의 서사와 단단해진 관계와 시간들이 느껴졌습니다. 그 노력이 담긴 음악을 듣고 그 소중한 과정까지 함께 지켜볼 수 있어서 저에겐 너무 큰 위로이자 힘이 됩니다. 사람들에게 늘 긍정적인 힘을 주는 엔플라잉이 있어서 저는 참 행복해요. 환절기라는 곡이 정말 좋아서 매일 듣고 있는데요. 앞으로도 늘 변함없이 응원할게요! 노래 너무너무 좋아요

text:
Hi 🙂 Everyone, thank you NFlying. Let me share with you 3 of my favorite Bible verses: When you please the Lord, you can make your enemies into friends, Proverbs 16:7. What is desired in a man is kindness, Proverbs 19:22. Jesus taught us whom to fear, "Don't be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear God who can destroy both body and soul in hell." Matthew 10:28.

As soon as I am born again, John 3:3, into God's family, John 1:12. I have a deposit in the spiritual world of all that I need to live life, life in all its fullness. For Jesus said, "I came, in order that you might have life, life in all its fullness." John 10:10.

Now if I don't know that the deposit to live life in all it's fullness is there, or if I know, but do not claim it in Jesus' name, then instead of living like the richest person I really am, I would still be living like a poor, begging 🙁

First, this is the Good News of how ANYONE can be born again into God's family: Believe now and say, "I have decided to follow Jesus, because he is the ONLY way to heaven, John 14:6. I turn away from all my sins, because Jesus said, 'From now on don't sin, John 8:11, a sinner REPENTS and becomes SAVED.' Luke 15:10. So be it in Jesus' name, Hallelujah!"

Then know that all you need: Health, finance, peace and joy are all in your spiritual account. Ask for them in Jesus' name and never stop to give thanks for them, until you see them in this physical world 🙂

When I ask for something in Jesus' name, I believe I receive it the moment I ask, Mark 11:23,24. I can see it in my mind, it is already there in the spiritual world 🙂 Now I keep on THANKING God for it, every time I think about it, until I see it in this physical world 🙂

John said, "Now this is the confidence that we have in God, that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us. And if we know that He hears us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we have asked of Him, 1 John 5:14,15.

God made us sit in Jesus, Ephesians 2:6, in the highest position in heaven, far above all rulers, authorities and powers, Ephesians 1:21, to reign in life through Jesus, Romans 5:17. How? By asking anything in Jesus' name and Jesus said, "In my name ask and you will receive, that your joy may be full." John 16:24.

Now this is how I end my prayer, "So be it in Jesus' name, thank you so much Daddy God that Jesus said, 'In my name ask and you will receive, that your joy may be full.' John 16:24 Hallelujah!"

The Lord God said, "You are dust, and you will return to dust." Genesis 3:19. 'People die ONCE, and after that they are judged by God.' Hebrews 9:27. So there is no reincarnation!

My body will die and go back to the earth. But I was made in the image of God, Genesis 1:27, and God is Spirit, John 4:24. So I am a 'spirit' being who will live for eternity, either in heaven or in hell.

After someone dies, either he is with Jesus in paradise, Luke 23:43, or he is in hell where he is constantly tortured as Jesus said in Luke 16:23, in the sea of ever-burning fire, which is the second death, Revelation 21:8.

If I do not believe that 'Jesus died in my place for my sins.' Galatians 2:20, then I am 'already condemned' to pay for my sins in hell, John 3:18. Jesus said, "In hell worms that eat the body never die, and the fire is never put out." Mark 9:48.

Someone was near death and was struggling on his bed. His family told him to call on the name of the Lord Jesus, he did and died with so much peace that his wife said that she too, wanted to follow Jesus.

Watch this short video: Russia drilled the deepest hole on earth. They recorded this: Thousands of voices screaming in agony! This proves that HELL IS A REAL PLACE! https://www.youtube.com/shorts/oLqWVcKuHsw

Do you know the Good News of how you can go to heaven? Believe now and say, "I have decided to follow Jesus, because he is the ONLY way to heaven, John 14:6. text:
Hi 🙂 Everyone, thank you NFlying. Let me share with you one of my favorite Bible verses: Paul said, "I discipline my body and bring it under complete control, to keep myself from being disqualified after having preached to others." 1 Corinthians 9:27.

God is so good that he has given every person 3 chances not to go to hell where he will be constantly tortured, Luke 16:23 in the sea of ever-burning fire which is the second death, Revelation 21:8.

First chance: God so loved us that he gave us Jesus, to pay for our sins in our place, 1 John 4:10. Jesus said, "If you live by what I say, you are truly my disciples, John 8:31. From now on don't sin, John 8:11. I tell you that if you do not repent, that is, turn away from your sins, you will perish." Luke 13:3.

Second chance: God has poured out his Spirit on everyone, Acts 2:17. Why? So that every person will succeed to turn away from his sins and be saved, Luke 15:10. "You won't succeed by might or by power, but by my Spirit, says the LORD, Zechariah 4:6.

Third chance: After Jesus has taken away every person who were following and obeying him, to heaven, John 14:3. You can still decide to follow Jesus to heaven, but you will have to go through the great tribulation, Matthew 24:21, which will last for 7 years!

The Lord is not slow to do what he has promised, as some think. Instead, he is patient with you, because he does not want anyone to be destroyed, but wants all to turn away from their sins, 2 Peter 3:9.

Jesus said, "If the world hates you, realize that it hated me before it hated you. If you had anything in common with the world, the world would love you as one of its own. But you don't have anything in common with the world. I chose you from the world, and that's why the world hates you.

"Remember what I told you: ‘A servant isn't greater than his master.' If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they did what I said, they will also do what you say. Indeed, they will do all this to you because you are committed to me." John 15:18-21.

Daddy God is so good, he wants us to always be joyful 🙂 He has put us in Jesus, 1 Corinthians 1:30, and he said, "Always be joyful in Jesus! I'll say it again: Be joyful! Philippians 4:4. Why? Because being cheerful keeps us healthy, Proverbs 17:22, and happy people always enjoy life, Proverbs 15:15 🙂

Do you know the Good News of how you can go to heaven? Believe now and say, "I have decided to follow Jesus, because he is the ONLY way to heaven, John 14:6. I turn away from all my sins, because Jesus said, 'From now on don't sin, John 8:11, a sinner REPENTS and becomes SAVED.' Luke 15:10. So be it in Jesus' name, Hallelujah!"

text:
Hi 🙂 Everyone, thank you NFlying. Let me share with you one of my favorite Bible verses: Daddy God says, "I am the high and holy God, who lives forever. I live in a high and holy place, but I also live with people who are humble and repentant, so that I can restore their confidence and hope." Isaiah 57:15.

James said, "Each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own desires." James 1:14. These men in the photo running away from the bear reminds me of how Joseph ran.

Joseph taught us what to do in front of temptation: She grabbed him by his clothes and said, “Come to bed with me!” But he ran outside, Genesis 39:12.

Jesus was tempted in every way that we are, but he didn't sin, Hebrews 4:15. He is indeed the expert who can help us.

Paul said, "There isn't any temptation that you have experienced which is unusual for humans. God, who faithfully keeps his promises, will not allow you to be tempted beyond your power to resist, but with the temptation will also provide the way of escape." 1 Corinthians 10:13.

Do you know the Good News of how you can go to heaven? Believe now and say, "I have decided to follow Jesus, because he is the ONLY way to heaven, John 14:6. I turn away from all my sins, because Jesus said, 'From now on don't sin, John 8:11, a sinner REPENTS and becomes SAVED.' Luke 15:10. So be it in Jesus' name, Hallelujah!"

text:
Their Killing Voice is a good way to get to know their music and how they are on the concerts (just add more chaos to it).
Here is some basic info:
N.Flying[엔플라잉] is short for New Flying which also means 'new wings' or 'new escape'. N.Flying indie debut was on 1st Oct 2013 in Japan, and 20th May 2015 in Korea, under FNC Entertainment. They were supposed to make their debut in Korea in 2014, but it was delayed because Seunghyub (leader) injured his knee.
Official Fandom Name : N.Fia [ Nflying + Utopia ] It means “Let’s fly to utopia together.”
Official Mascort: N.Fie

They debuted as a 4 member band: vocalist/rapper, drumer, guitarist and bassist. Iin 2017 they added another vocalist Yoo Hweseung and the leader and vocalist Seunghyub rearrange all their old songs for him (change key etc) in 2019 the old bassist left coz of some stuff so in 2020 they officialy added a new bassist and now they are 5 member:

Lee Seunghyub (leader) - vocalist, rapper, keyborist, guitarist, writter, composer
Cha Hun - main guitarist, backup vocals
Kim Jaehyun (ex ex maknae [from 2013-2017]) - drummer
Yoo Hweseung (ex maknae [from 2017-2020]) - main vocalist, acustic/electric guitar
Soe Dongsung (maknae from 2020) - bassist, backup vocals
